card.ethical_and_safety_notes: Output is a recommendation, never an action. Policy and the Safety Governor stand between this model and any device.
card.evaluation: Held-out final 5 days; mean absolute error 0.6 °C.
card.intended_use: Proposing a comfort setpoint for review. Advisory only.
card.limitations: Cold-starts for the first three weeks and after a household change. Suspended automatically when drift is detected.
card.out_of_scope_use: Any safety decision, any life-safety actuator, and any home other than the one it was trained on.
card.summary: Predicts the temperature this household chooses at this hour.
card.training_data: 21 days of this home's own thermostat changes. No data leaves the hub.
